name: motif_add_inflection_class
description:
Author inflection class. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if a group of stems takes different affix forms with the same meaning, not set by sound or agreement; otherwise use an inflection feature or environment. Define it at the highest category; one stem is not a class (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Adds an inflection class or subclass, such as a noun class, to a Draft. Its owner is explicit and the category's default is unchanged; use the created id when authoring a stem.
Command: compose-author-inflection-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed inflection class input, resolved against the prepared Draft.

category.description: Canonical id of the category owning this class tree.

name.description: Inflection class name, such as a noun class.

ws.description: Writing system tag for the name and abbreviation.

parent.description: Optional existing parent class in the declared category.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
